about: Stages and timing for the fix-one-search playbook. scripts/handoff.py reads this file: the stages it tracks, the outcomes each stage can record, and how long to wait between stages. Each key is explained under notes.

stages.name: diagnose
stages.do: Diagnose why the search underperforms, add its recommended fixes as findings, and agree with the user which one to make (or which product to look at).

stages.name: visibility
stages.do: Explain why the named product is missing or buried for the search, add its causes as findings, and agree which fix to make.

skip_when.reason: the diagnosis already chose a fix and no single product needs explaining.
the diagnosis found nothing to fix in search.

stages.name: qa
stages.do: Check the chosen fix before anything is written: GO, GO WITH CAUTION or NO-GO, and which way it goes (synonym, redirect, ranking test, or a fix outside search).

skip_when.reason: the diagnosis found nothing to fix in search.
the product check found nothing to fix.

stages.name: synonyms
stages.do: Plan the synonym, preview it, create it switched off and switch it on, each batch after its own yes.

skip_when.reason: the chosen fix isn't a synonym, or it failed QA.
the qa stage was skipped, so no fix was checked to make.

stages.name: redirect
stages.do: Plan the redirect change, check it, create a new redirect switched off and switch it on, each batch after its own yes.

skip_when.reason: the chosen fix isn't a redirect, or it failed QA.
the qa stage was skipped, so no fix was checked to make.

stages.name: measure
stages.do: Check the fix paid off for the search, with the change and its live date from the hand-off file.

skip_when.reason: nothing changed in this run: a ranking fix is measured by its own test-and-learn run, and other fixes belong to other skills.
the qa stage was skipped, so nothing was changed.
the synonym never went live, so there is nothing to measure.
the redirect change never went live, so there is nothing to measure.

notes.measure_after_days: Days before the measure stage is due. The script counts them from the qa stage, as a floor; the synonyms or redirect stage also sets the measure stage's date from the day the fix went live, which is the date that matters. change-impact-tracker needs about 14 days of data after a change for a verdict other than too early to tell.
notes.wait_outcomes: Outcomes that mean a stage isn't finished yet. The script records them only with status in_progress and a --not-before date to come back on, so status never shows the stage as due before then.
notes.playbooks: Each playbook's title, product and stages in order. A stage names the skill that does it, whether that skill writes, what to do, the outcomes it can record, not_before (wait this rules key's number of days after another stage is done) and skip_when (suggest skipping when an earlier stage had one of these outcomes, or with skipped: true when it was skipped; all means every condition must hold). The synonyms and redirect stages are alternatives: the qa stage's outcome says which one the chosen fix needs, and the other is offered as a skip.
